item.title: How to get yesterday's date in JavaScript
item.description: Getting yesterday’s date is essential for data comparisons, log analysis, and building time-sensitive application features. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented date calculations in analytics dashboards and reporting components countless times. The most reliable method is using setDate() with getDate() - 1 which automatically handles month and year boundaries. This approach eliminates the complexity of manual date arithmetic and daylight saving time issues.
